title: Starting state
note: Source supports an as_is continuity_fingerprint of stable regular files, checked under the lease before setup and again before mission walking; continuity_lost refuses without starting on missing, changed or uncheckable state. This detects loss between leases; it does not reserve the host. macOS restore retries a failed captured-entry copy once, preserves the existing reset boundary, and refuses persistent failure with its unrestored-entry receipt. Live proof remains pending.
